# Cosmos Cookbook
## Case Study Recipes
### [**Cosmos Transfer**](https://github.com/nvidia-cosmos/cosmos-transfer2.5)
#### Multi-control video generation and augmentation
| **Workflow** | **Description** | **Link** |
|-|-|-|
| **Inference** | Style-guided video generation using image references with edge/depth/segmentation control | [Style-Guided Generation](https://nvidia-cosmos.github.io/cosmos-cookbook/recipes/inference/transfer2_5/inference-image-prompt/inference.html) |
| **Inference** | Multi-control video editing for background replacement, lighting, and object transformation | [Real-World Video Manipulation](https://nvidia-cosmos.github.io/cosmos-cookbook/recipes/inference/transfer2_5/inference-real-augmentation/inference.html) |
| **Training** | ControlNet post-training for spatially-conditioned multiview AV video generation with world scenario maps | [Multiview AV Generation](https://nvidia-cosmos.github.io/cosmos-cookbook/recipes/post_training/transfer2_5/av_world_scenario_maps/post_training.html) |

#### Vision-language reasoning and quality control

|-|-|-|
| **Training** | 3D vehicle grounding in autonomous driving with Cosmos Reason 1 & 2 | [3D AV Grounding (Reason 1 & 2)](https://nvidia-cosmos.github.io/cosmos-cookbook/recipes/post_training/reason2/av_3d_grounding/post_training.html) |
| **Training** | Post-training Cosmos Reason 2 for AV video captioning and VQA with production data | [AV Video Caption VQA (Reason 2)](https://nvidia-cosmos.github.io/cosmos-cookbook/recipes/post_training/reason2/video_caption_vqa/post_training.html) |
